errors.text_span: A light purple solid line with circular markers represents "Tanh"

errors.text_span: A purple, solid line with circular markers represents "ELU"
errors.evidence: Reference describes ELU as a light purple line, while the machine-generated description assigns purple to ELU and light purple to Tanh, reversing the color assignments.
